body.condition: \(D_{\lambda}G_T(\beta)=0\) for every \(n\), every balanced \(T\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}\), and every \(\beta\in\mathcal K\).

novel.justification: Conditional outcome models can separate covariate-slope directions determining balance geometry from intercept and dispersion directions that affect likelihood but not the oracle score.
